segment.name: Lloyd's
segment.systems: Binder admin system · MRC slip library (SharePoint) · bordereaux spreadsheets · Crystal + CDR · ATLAS · Xchanging/DXC bureau messaging
segment.operatingPattern: Syndicate underwriting through delegated authority binders, broker lineslips and open-market MRC slips — subscription placement at the box, bureau back office, monthly bordereaux from coverholders.
segment.distribution: Lloyd's brokers, approved coverholders, service companies
segment.placement: Subscription market — leader plus following market on the MRC slip; binding authorities for DA business
segment.reinsurance: Syndicate-level outwards programme; per-YOA cat aggregate management by cat zone
segment.regulatory: Lloyd's minimum standards and oversight — Crystal territory requirements, Core Data Record, ATLAS coverholder approvals, bordereaux and trust fund obligations

behavior.Product Taxonomy: No product master exists — identity is the Lloyd's risk code, YOA and UMR on the slip or binder; class granularity lives in binder schedules.
behavior.Coverages: Cover is whatever the MRC wording plus LMA/NMA clauses say; DA cover is defined class-by-class in the binder schedule, not in any system.
behavior.Terms: Slip terms — line size, order %, written vs signed lines — plus binder limits and YOA aggregates; signed lines only final after bureau signing.
behavior.Rating: Coverholder rate matrices bound into the binder schedule; open-market rating is underwriter judgment benchmarked against PMD premium/exposure packs.
behavior.Pricing: Brokerage on the slip, coverholder and profit commissions in the binder, taxes resolved per territory via Crystal and shown in the Fiscal & Regulatory section.
behavior.Underwriting Rules: Binder authority defines eligible classes/limits/territories with everything else referred; aggregate exposure monitored per cat zone and YOA from bordereaux.
behavior.Forms: MRC slip sections (Risk Details, Information, Security Details) plus the LMA clause library and model binder wordings with schedules.
behavior.Filings: CDR submissions at placement, Crystal checks per territory, bordereaux deadlines, ATLAS coverholder audits and US situs trust fund arrangements.
behavior.Lifecycle Behavior: Slip preparation, leader quote, subscription, bureau signing; binder risks-written records and monthly bordereaux; YOA renewal creates a new binder period.

products.name: Property Binder (DA)
products.description: Delegated authority binding authority for residential and commercial property worldwide excluding US, coverholder-rated per the binder schedule with monthly risk, premium and claims bordereaux.

components.name: Product Taxonomy
components.expression: Risk code + UMR + YOA is the whole product identity

items.name: Lloyd's risk code B2 (property binder)
items.description: The binder's business is coded B2 property binder for Lloyd's reporting — the risk code, not a product master, is what Lloyd's sees.
items.livesIn: MRC slip Risk Details — risk code field; CDR submission

items.name: UMR B0507PB2600126
items.description: Unique Market Reference in B0-broker-number format identifying this binding authority across bureau, Crystal and bordereaux for its life.
items.livesIn: MRC slip header; binder admin system contract record

items.name: 2026 YOA structure
items.description: Risks attaching 01/01/2026–31/12/2026 allocate to the 2026 year of account; premium and claims follow the YOA through the 3-year accounting cycle.
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — YOA field on risks written records

items.name: Coverholder ATLAS PIN
items.description: The coverholder's Lloyd's approval record (PIN) in ATLAS, referenced on the slip and checked at binder registration and renewal.
items.livesIn: ATLAS — coverholder record; PIN quoted in MRC Risk Details

items.name: Binder sections per class
items.description: Two binder sections — Section 1 residential property, Section 2 commercial property — each with its own schedule of limits, rates and territories.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule appended to the MRC — slip library (SharePoint)

items.name: Territory schedule
items.description: Authorized territories: UK, Ireland, EU (via Lloyd's Europe), Australia, New Zealand, Caribbean ex-US — US-situs risks expressly excluded.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — territory section; Crystal check record

items.name: YOA lineage 2024→2026
items.description: Continuous binder relationship renewed each YOA; 2025 YOA in runoff, 2024 closed via RITC — lineage tracked by UMR suffix per year.
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — contract lineage; renewal pack in slip library

components.name: Coverages
components.expression: Class covers defined by the binder schedule, per territory

items.name: Residential buildings & contents all risks
items.description: Section 1 all-risks cover on homeowner buildings and contents per the schedule wording, written by the coverholder within schedule limits.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule Section 1 + territory wording — slip library

items.name: Commercial property all risks (FLEXA base)
items.description: Section 2 cover on commercial buildings, contents and stock — fire, lightning, explosion, aircraft base extended to all risks per schedule occupancy list.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule Section 2 — slip library

items.name: Caribbean windstorm (named peril, per territory)
items.description: Windstorm cover in Caribbean territories subject to per-risk wind deductibles and the binder's Caribbean wind aggregate.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — Caribbean territory annex; aggregate tracked in bordereaux spreadsheet

items.name: Earthquake (NZ / selected territories)
items.description: EQ cover only in scheduled territories (NZ, selected EU zones) with its own deductible scale and zonal aggregate cap.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — EQ annex; cat zone aggregate sheet

items.name: Flood (territory-restricted with aggregates)
items.description: Flood cover available per territory annex, excluded in named flood zones, with a binder-level flood aggregate per YOA.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — flood annex; bordereaux aggregate columns

items.name: UK subsidence
items.description: Subsidence, heave and landslip on UK residential risks per standard UK market practice, £1,000 subsidence excess.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule Section 1 — UK annex

items.name: Loss of rent / alternative accommodation
items.description: Consequential cover at 20% of buildings sum insured on residential; loss of rent receivable on commercial per schedule.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — consequential loss items

items.name: Theft and escape of water
items.description: Standard theft (forcible entry definition) and escape-of-water perils within the all-risks grants, with unoccupancy restrictions.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule wording — perils and restrictions section

items.name: Property owners' liability (optional section)
items.description: Optional £2M POL cover attachable to commercial risks where the schedule permits, coded to the binder's liability sub-section.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule Section 2 — optional POL annex

components.name: Terms
components.expression: Line, order, and YOA aggregate discipline

items.name: Maximum limit any one risk GBP 2.5M
items.description: Coverholder may bind up to £2.5M sum insured any one risk (£1M Caribbean); larger risks must be referred to the box.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — limits section; MRC Risk Details

items.name: Binder premium income limit GBP 25M
items.description: Estimated/maximum gross premium income for the 2026 YOA; writing beyond the income limit requires an addendum.
items.livesIn: MRC Risk Details — premium income limit; monitored via premium bordereaux

items.name: Syndicate written line 60% / order 100%
items.description: Lead syndicate wrote 60%, two followers complete the 100% order; signed lines fixed at written lines (no signing down) per the slip.
items.livesIn: MRC Security Details — written/signed lines; DXC signing message

items.name: Cat zone aggregate limits
items.description: Caribbean wind aggregate £8M, NZ EQ aggregate £5M, flood aggregate £4M per YOA — breach stops binding in that zone.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — aggregates; tracked monthly in bordereaux spreadsheet

items.name: Peril deductibles
items.description: Wind 2% of sum insured (min £5k) Caribbean, EQ 5% NZ, standard £250–£1,000 attritional excesses per schedule.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — deductibles table

items.name: Binder period & cancellation
items.description: 12 months at 01/01/2026 with 30-day notice of cancellation either side; risks bound before cancellation run to natural expiry.
items.livesIn: MRC Risk Details — period and cancellation provisions

items.name: Premium payment / settlement terms
items.description: Bordereaux premium settled to the bureau within 45 days of month end; late settlement is a binder event of default.
items.livesIn: MRC — settlement due date clause; DXC settlement records

items.name: Claims handling authority GBP 25k
items.description: Coverholder handles and settles claims up to £25k per the claims agreement annex; above that, claims route to the syndicate via ECF.
items.livesIn: Binder claims annex — slip library; ECF claim files

components.name: Rating
components.expression: Coverholder rate matrix, PMD-benchmarked

items.name: Coverholder rate matrix per class/territory
items.description: The binder schedule's rate tables — rate per mille by construction, occupancy and territory — are the only rating engine; the coverholder applies them at point of sale.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — rate matrix annex; slip library (SharePoint)

items.name: Construction/occupancy relativities
items.description: Rate relativities for construction class (standard/non-standard, timber-frame loading) and occupancy (owner-occupied vs let, trade classes on commercial).
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — rate matrix rows

items.name: Cat loadings per zone
items.description: Wind and EQ loadings by cat zone added to base rates in exposed territories, aligned to the aggregate caps.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — cat loading table

items.name: Minimum rates & discount cap
items.description: Schedule minimum rates per class; coverholder discretionary discount capped at 10% — beyond that the risk is a referral.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — rating rules; referral email trail

items.name: PMD premium/exposure benchmarks
items.description: Quarterly comparison of binder rate adequacy against the syndicate's PMD (performance management data) benchmarks for B2 property.
items.livesIn: Syndicate PMD pack — underwriting performance folder

items.name: YOA-on-YOA rate change tracking
items.description: Renewal pack quantifies 2026 vs 2025 rate movement per section (target +7.5% Caribbean, flat UK) as the basis of the leader's renewal quote.
items.livesIn: Binder renewal pack — slip library

components.name: Pricing
components.expression: Commission stack + Crystal tax schedules

items.name: Coverholder commission 22.5%
items.description: Coverholder retains 22.5% of gross premium as commission, deducted before bordereaux settlement.
items.livesIn: MRC Risk Details — coverholder commission; premium bordereaux net columns

items.name: Profit commission 15% over 50% loss ratio
items.description: Coverholder earns 15% profit commission on the YOA underwriting profit subject to a 50% loss ratio threshold, calculated at 24 and 36 months.
items.livesIn: MRC — profit commission clause; PC calculation spreadsheet, underwriting folder

items.name: Lloyd's brokerage 10%
items.description: Placing broker's brokerage of 10% on the slip, deducted at bureau signing.
items.livesIn: MRC Security Details — brokerage; DXC signing/LPAN records

items.name: UK IPT 12%
items.description: Insurance premium tax at 12% on UK-located risks, charged to the insured by the coverholder and shown in the premium bordereaux tax columns.
items.livesIn: Crystal — UK requirements; bordereaux tax columns

items.name: Territory tax schedules via Crystal
items.description: Per-territory premium taxes and parafiscal charges (Australia stamp duty by state, EU IPT via Lloyd's Europe) resolved from Crystal and encoded in the Fiscal & Regulatory section.
items.livesIn: Crystal territory records; MRC Fiscal & Regulatory section

items.name: Policy/administration fees disclosure
items.description: Coverholder policy fees permitted only where the schedule allows and must be disclosed separately from premium in the bordereaux.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — fees rule; premium bordereaux fee column

items.name: Net-to-syndicate walk
items.description: Standard walk from gross premium through commission, brokerage and taxes to net premium signed to the syndicate — reconciled monthly against DXC signings.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux reconciliation spreadsheet — underwriting operations folder

components.name: Underwriting Rules
components.expression: Authority is the binder schedule; everything else referred

items.name: Eligible classes only
items.description: Coverholder may bind only the scheduled classes (residential, listed commercial occupancies); unlisted occupancies are automatic referrals to the box.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — eligible classes; referral email trail

items.name: Territory authority
items.description: Binding restricted to scheduled territories; US-situs risks prohibited outright, sanctioned territories excluded per LMA3100.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — territory annex; Crystal checks

items.name: Limit referrals above schedule caps
items.description: Any risk above £2.5M (£1M Caribbean) or TIV above £5M must be referred and, if agreed, bound as an open-market risk not under the binder.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — limits; box referral log

items.name: Cat aggregate monitoring per zone/YOA
items.description: Monthly aggregate roll-up per cat zone from the risk bordereaux; binding in a zone suspends automatically at 90% of the zonal aggregate.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux spreadsheet — aggregate tab; monthly DA oversight pack

items.name: No sub-delegation
items.description: Coverholder may not sub-delegate binding authority; any introducer arrangement must be disclosed and approved via ATLAS.
items.livesIn: MRC binding authority conditions; ATLAS coverholder record

items.name: Sanctions screening (LMA3100)
items.description: Sanctions limitation clause applies to every risk bound; coverholder warrants screening against UK/EU/OFAC lists at point of sale.
items.livesIn: LMA3100 in binder wording; coverholder compliance annex

items.name: Unoccupancy & high-hazard restrictions
items.description: Unoccupied properties >30 days, thatch, and heritage-listed buildings are outside authority and referred.
items.livesIn: Binder schedule — restrictions list

items.name: Claims authority cap & reporting
items.description: Claims above £25k, all liability claims, and any claim with coverage doubt must be reported to the syndicate within 48 hours.
items.livesIn: Binder claims annex; ECF claim records

components.name: Forms
components.expression: Model binder wording + LMA clause set + MRC sections

items.name: LMA3113 model binding authority agreement
items.description: The binder contract itself, on the Lloyd's model binding authority wording with schedule-driven variables.
items.livesIn: LMA clause library + executed copy in slip library (SharePoint)

items.name: MRC slip — Risk Details / Information / Security Details
items.description: The Market Reform Contract placing the binder, with Risk Details (period, limits, commissions), Information, and Security Details (stamps and lines) sections.
items.livesIn: MRC slip library (SharePoint) — UMR B0507PB2600126 folder

items.name: Binder schedule & annexes
items.description: The operative schedules — classes, limits, rates, territories, deductibles, aggregates, claims authority — that define what the coverholder can actually sell.
items.livesIn: Slip library — schedule annexes to the MRC

items.name: LMA3100 sanctions limitation clause
items.description: Standard market sanctions limitation and exclusion clause incorporated into the binder and all certificates.
items.livesIn: LMA clause library; referenced in binder wording

items.name: LMA5401 property cyber endorsement
items.description: Property cyber write-back endorsement (data/cyber loss clarification) applied to property covers per Lloyd's cyber-clarity mandate.
items.livesIn: LMA clause library; binder wording endorsement list

items.name: NMA2918 war & terrorism exclusion
items.description: Standard war and terrorism exclusion on all property certificates, with terrorism buy-back unavailable under this binder.
items.livesIn: LMA/NMA clause library; certificate wording

items.name: LMA5393 communicable disease exclusion
items.description: Property communicable disease exclusion applied market-wide since 2020, attached to all certificates.
items.livesIn: LMA clause library; certificate wording

items.name: Certificate of insurance template
items.description: The coverholder-issued certificate template evidencing each risk bound, referencing the UMR and binder terms.
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — certificate template; specimen in slip library

components.name: Filings
components.expression: CDR, Crystal, bordereaux deadlines, ATLAS audits

items.name: CDR submission at binder registration
items.description: Core Data Record fields (UMR, risk code, YOA, territories, coverholder PIN) submitted at placement for Lloyd's digital processing.
items.livesIn: CDR submission record; binder admin system contract data

items.name: Binding authority registration (DCOM)
items.description: Binder registered in Lloyd's delegated contract oversight platform before any risk may attach.
items.livesIn: DCOM registration record; copy in slip library folder

items.name: Crystal territory requirement checks
items.description: Per-territory licensing and documentation requirements (Lloyd's licensed vs accredited status, local policy wording rules) verified in Crystal for every scheduled territory.
items.livesIn: Crystal — territory check extracts, compliance folder

items.name: Monthly risk bordereaux deadline
items.description: Risks-written bordereaux due within 15 days of month end in the agreed spreadsheet format; late bordereaux escalate to the DA oversight meeting.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux spreadsheets — monthly risk files; submission log

items.name: Monthly premium & paid claims bordereaux
items.description: Premium bordereaux (with tax and commission columns) and claims bordereaux due on the same 15-day cycle, reconciled to DXC signings.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux spreadsheets — premium/claims files; reconciliation tab

items.name: ATLAS coverholder annual audit
items.description: Coverholder audit scheduled through ATLAS covering underwriting-within-authority, claims handling, CBS/client money — findings tracked to closure.
items.livesIn: ATLAS — audit file; audit report in compliance folder

items.name: US situs check (trust funds not applicable)
items.description: Ex-US binder carries a situs check at risk entry confirming no US trust fund (CRTF/SLTF) obligations arise; any US-situs risk found is voided and referred.
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — situs validation; compliance memo

components.name: Lifecycle Behavior
components.expression: Slip → subscription → coverholder binds → bordereaux → YOA renewal

items.name: Binder renewal pack & slip preparation
items.description: Broker assembles the renewal pack (YOA performance, rate change, aggregate usage) and prepares the 2026 MRC for the leader.
items.livesIn: Slip library — renewal pack + draft MRC

items.name: Leader quote & terms
items.description: Lead underwriter quotes line and terms on the slip — rate uplift, aggregate changes, schedule amendments — stamped in Security Details.
items.livesIn: MRC Security Details — leader stamp; box records

items.name: Following market subscription
items.description: Broker completes the 100% order with following syndicates subscribing to the leader's terms under the GUA.
items.livesIn: MRC Security Details — following stamps and written lines

items.name: Bureau signing (Xchanging/DXC)
items.description: Slip submitted for signing; premium processed via LPANs and signed lines confirmed back through bureau messaging.
items.livesIn: DXC bureau messaging — signing & LPAN records

items.name: Registration & coverholder go-live
items.description: Binder registered (DCOM), ATLAS status confirmed, and the coverholder authorized to bind from 01/01 — certificates issue from the binder admin system.
items.livesIn: DCOM + ATLAS records; binder admin system activation

items.name: Risks written records (per certificate, YOA-tagged)
items.description: Every risk bound is recorded in the binder admin system with certificate number, sum insured, territory, cat zone and 2026 YOA tag.
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — risks written records

items.name: Monthly bordereaux cycle & reconciliation
items.description: Risk/premium/claims bordereaux uploaded monthly, reconciled to the binder admin system and DXC settlements; queries bounce back to the coverholder.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux spreadsheets + reconciliation tab; DXC settlement records

items.name: Addenda (MRC endorsements)
items.description: Mid-term binder changes — aggregate top-ups, schedule amendments, territory additions — agreed as slip addenda stamped by agreement parties.
items.livesIn: Slip library — addenda folder under the UMR

items.name: Claims flow via bureau messaging
items.description: Coverholder-handled claims report through claims bordereaux; above-authority claims open on ECF for syndicate agreement and bureau settlement.
items.livesIn: ECF claim files; claims bordereaux spreadsheets

items.name: YOA renewal (new binder period)
items.description: The 2027 renewal creates a new binder period and UMR-year: 2026 risks run to natural expiry under 2026 YOA while new risks attach to 2027.
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — YOA rollover; renewal pack in slip library

components.name: Product Taxonomy
components.expression: Expired YOA — identity frozen, running to natural expiry

items.name: Lloyd's risk code B2 (2025 YOA)
items.description: Same B2 property binder coding; 2025-attached risks continue to report under the 2025 year of account until closure.
items.livesIn: CDR record; binder admin system YOA field

items.name: UMR B0507PB2500125
items.description: The 2025 binder-year UMR — still the reference for all runoff premium, claims and profit-commission transactions.
items.livesIn: MRC slip header (2025); binder admin system contract record

items.name: 2025 YOA in runoff
items.description: Binder expired 31/12/2025; no new risks attach, but risks bound in 2025 remain on cover to natural expiry (up to 31/12/2026).
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — contract status; risks written records

items.name: 3-year accounting position
items.description: 2025 YOA remains open in the syndicate's 3-year accounting until closure at 36 months (expected RITC into 2026 at YE2027).
items.livesIn: Syndicate accounts — YOA schedule; underwriting performance folder

items.name: Schedule differences vs 2026
items.description: 2025 schedule had a higher Caribbean wind aggregate (£10M) and included two commercial occupancies removed at the 2026 renewal.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule — slip library archive

components.name: Coverages
components.expression: 2025 schedule covers, frozen for in-force certificates

items.name: Residential buildings & contents all risks (2025 terms)
items.description: Section 1 cover as scheduled for 2025 — certificates in force keep 2025 terms even after binder expiry.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule Section 1 — slip library archive

items.name: Commercial property all risks (broader 2025 occupancy list)
items.description: Section 2 with the pre-cull occupancy list including waste-adjacent and food-processing risks later removed for 2026.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule Section 2 — archive

items.name: Caribbean windstorm (2025 aggregate)
items.description: Wind cover on 2025 certificates counted against the 2025 £10M wind aggregate; runoff exposure decays as certificates expire monthly.
items.livesIn: 2025 schedule Caribbean annex; runoff aggregate tab in bordereaux spreadsheet

items.name: Flood and EQ per 2025 annexes
items.description: Flood and NZ EQ covers per the 2025 annexes, continuing on in-force certificates through their natural expiry.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule annexes — archive

items.name: Loss of rent / alternative accommodation
items.description: Consequential covers on 2025 certificates unchanged; claims continue to emerge during runoff.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule — consequential loss items

items.name: Property owners' liability (2025 optional section)
items.description: POL sections bound during 2025 remain live; liability claims have the longest runoff tail on this YOA.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule — POL annex; ECF liability claim files

components.name: Terms
components.expression: No new attachments; in-force terms run off

items.name: No new risks after 31/12/2025
items.description: Binding authority ceased at expiry — any certificate dated after 31/12/2025 is outside authority and repudiated back to the coverholder.
items.livesIn: MRC (2025) period clause; binder admin system attachment validation

items.name: Natural expiry of in-force certificates
items.description: 2025-attached 12-month certificates expire progressively through 2026; the runoff report tracks the declining in-force count monthly.
items.livesIn: Binder admin system — in-force runoff report

items.name: 2025 line structure (55%/order 100%)
items.description: Lead wrote 55% in 2025 with three followers; the different panel from 2026 matters for claim agreement on runoff claims.
items.livesIn: MRC (2025) Security Details; DXC signing records

items.name: Runoff settlement terms
items.description: Premium adjustments and return premiums on cancelled certificates continue through bordereaux settlement on the 45-day cycle.
items.livesIn: Premium bordereaux (runoff months); DXC settlement records

items.name: Claims handling authority continues
items.description: Coverholder retains £25k claims authority for 2025-YOA claims until the last certificate expires and the claims bordereaux closes.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder claims annex; claims bordereaux

components.name: Rating
components.expression: 2025 matrices closed; used only for return-premium math

items.name: 2025 rate matrix (frozen)
items.description: The 2025 schedule rate tables are closed to new use but remain the basis for computing return premiums and mid-term adjustments on in-force certificates.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule rate matrix — slip library archive

items.name: Pro-rata / short-rate return premium scale
items.description: Cancellation return premiums on 2025 certificates computed per the schedule's return scale and reported in the premium bordereaux.
items.livesIn: 2025 binder schedule — cancellation scale; bordereaux return columns

items.name: 2025 rate adequacy reforecast
items.description: Actual 2025 YOA loss ratio versus plan tracked quarterly during runoff — the key input to the 2026 renewal pricing already applied.
items.livesIn: Syndicate PMD pack — 2025 YOA performance pages

items.name: Cat loading experience review
items.description: Post-season review of Caribbean wind loadings against 2025 hurricane activity feeding the 2026 +7.5% uplift decision.
items.livesIn: Underwriting performance folder — 2025 cat review memo

items.name: Discount-cap breach findings
items.description: 2025 audit found discounting beyond the 10% cap on 14 certificates — remediation tracked and rate rules tightened in the 2026 schedule.
items.livesIn: ATLAS audit report 2025 — findings log

components.name: Pricing
components.expression: Runoff economics: PC true-up and tax finalization

items.name: Coverholder commission 22.5% (2025 terms)
items.description: Commission on runoff premium adjustments continues at the 2025 contractual rate.
items.livesIn: MRC (2025) — commission clause; bordereaux net columns

items.name: Profit commission true-up at 24/36 months
items.description: 2025 YOA profit commission provisionally calculated at 24 months (12/2026) and finalized at 36 months with claims development — the main open money item on this YOA.
items.livesIn: PC calculation spreadsheet — 2025 YOA tab; MRC PC clause

items.name: Brokerage 10% on runoff transactions
items.description: Brokerage continues to apply to additional/return premiums processed through the bureau during runoff.
items.livesIn: DXC LPAN records (2025 UMR)

items.name: Tax finalization per territory
items.description: IPT and territory taxes on 2025 premium finalized through the last bordereaux; corrections flow as tax-only bordereaux lines.
items.livesIn: Crystal schedules + bordereaux tax columns (runoff months)

items.name: Net runoff premium reporting
items.description: Monthly net premium movement (adjustments minus returns) reported to the syndicate until the YOA closes.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux reconciliation spreadsheet — 2025 runoff tab

components.name: Underwriting Rules
components.expression: Authority lapsed; oversight rules continue

items.name: Binding authority lapsed
items.description: All underwriting authority ceased at expiry; only mid-term administration of in-force certificates (cancellation, sum-insured reductions) is permitted.
items.livesIn: MRC (2025) — expiry provisions; binder admin system controls

items.name: Out-of-authority certificate checks
items.description: Runoff oversight re-checks late-reported certificates for attachment dates within the 2025 period — a standing audit item.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux review checklist; DA oversight pack

items.name: Aggregate runoff monitoring
items.description: Cat zone aggregates continue to be tracked on the declining in-force book through the 2026 hurricane season.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux spreadsheet — runoff aggregate tab

items.name: Sanctions screening on claims payments
items.description: LMA3100 screening applies to every runoff claim payment and return premium payee.
items.livesIn: Claims annex; coverholder compliance annex

items.name: 2025 audit remediation tracking
items.description: Open ATLAS audit findings (discount-cap breaches, late bordereaux) tracked to closure as a condition of the already-bound 2026 renewal.
items.livesIn: ATLAS — audit findings log; DA oversight minutes

components.name: Forms
components.expression: 2025 wording set frozen for in-force certificates

items.name: LMA3113 binding authority agreement (2025 execution)
items.description: The executed 2025 binder contract — the governing document for all runoff rights and obligations including PC and audit access.
items.livesIn: Slip library archive — 2025 UMR folder

items.name: MRC slip (2025) with addenda
items.description: The 2025 placing slip plus its three mid-term addenda (aggregate top-up, occupancy addition, claims-annex amendment).
items.livesIn: MRC slip library (SharePoint) — 2025 UMR folder

items.name: 2025 certificate wording set
items.description: Certificates in force retain the 2025 wording set — including the pre-2026 version of the escape-of-water restriction — until expiry.

items.name: LMA3100 / NMA2918 / LMA5393 clause set
items.description: Sanctions, war & terrorism and communicable disease clauses as attached to 2025 certificates, identical editions to 2026.
items.livesIn: LMA clause library; 2025 certificate wording

items.description: 2025 certificates carry the absolute property cyber exclusion LMA5400; the 2026 renewal moved to the LMA5401 write-back — a live difference on runoff claims.

components.expression: CDR + Crystal per destination; declaration reporting

items.name: CDR submission at placement
items.description: Core Data Record for the open cover filed at signing with risk code, UMR, assured domicile and premium structure.
items.livesIn: CDR submission record

items.name: Crystal checks per destination territory
items.description: Territory requirements verified for recurring destination countries — local certificate wording rules, compulsory local insurance laws (e.g. cargo import rules in Brazil/India noted as excluded destinations).
items.livesIn: Crystal — territory extracts; compliance folder

items.name: Quarterly declaration bordereau to the leader
items.description: Assured's shipment declarations summarized quarterly to leader and followers for premium adjustment and aggregation review.
items.livesIn: Declaration bordereau spreadsheets — slip file

items.name: War AP declarations per listed-area transit
items.description: Each JWC listed-area transit declared and filed with its war AP quotation before sailing.
items.livesIn: War AP declaration records — slip file; DXC signings

items.name: US situs / trust fund position
items.description: US-connected business recorded for Lloyd's US reporting; cargo written as exempt commercial marine where state law allows, logged in the compliance schedule.
items.livesIn: Compliance schedule — US situs log

items.name: Annual adjustment filing
items.description: Expiry adjustment of declared values against the M&D premium filed through the bureau as the closing premium transaction.
items.livesIn: DXC bureau messaging — adjustment signing

components.name: Lifecycle Behavior
components.expression: Slip → subscription → declarations → adjustment → re-slip

items.name: Slip preparation by the broker
items.description: Broker drafts the MRC from the expiring cover — commodity schedule, limits, rating lines — and presents to the leader at the box.
items.livesIn: Slip library — draft MRC; broker placing file

items.name: Leader quote (line and terms)
items.description: Leader prices the schedule, sets war AP terms and stamps a 30% written line in Security Details.
items.livesIn: MRC Security Details — leader stamp; box records

items.name: Following market subscription & signing down
items.description: Followers subscribe past 100% written; lines sign down pro-rata to the 100% signed order at closing.
items.livesIn: MRC Security Details — written vs signed lines

items.name: Bureau signing (DXC)
items.description: Slip signed through the bureau; M&D installments and subsequent declarations processed as LPANs against the UMR.
items.livesIn: DXC bureau messaging — signing & LPAN records

items.name: Shipment declarations under the open cover
items.description: Assured declares shipments (interest, value, vessel, voyage) via the broker; in-schedule shipments are automatically held covered from attachment.
items.livesIn: Declaration records — broker system + quarterly bordereau

items.name: Certificates issued per shipment
items.description: Negotiable insurance certificates issued against declarations for banks and consignees.
items.livesIn: Broker certificate issuance system

items.name: Mid-term endorsements as slip addenda (AP/RP)
items.description: Schedule changes, limit amendments and war-rate revisions processed as addenda with additional or return premium signed via the bureau.
items.livesIn: Slip library — addenda folder; DXC AP/RP signings

items.name: Claims via ECF and average adjusters
items.description: Cargo claims open on ECF with survey reports; GA cases route to average adjusters with the leader agreeing security and settlements for the following market.
items.livesIn: ECF claim files; average adjusters' correspondence

items.name: Expiry adjustment & 2027 re-slip
items.description: At expiry, declared values adjust the M&D premium, and the 2027 cover is re-slipped and re-subscribed as a new placement for the new YOA.
items.livesIn: DXC adjustment signing; renewal MRC in slip library
